selection_function.query_template: SELECT ra,dec,dnf_z,mcal_w_noshear FROM delve_dr3.decade_shear WHERE 't' = q3c_radial_query(ra, dec, <RA>, <DEC>, <RAD>) AND mcal_flags = 0 AND flags_foreground = 0 AND flags_footprint = 1 AND mcal_sel_noshear > 0 AND dnf_z > 0 AND dnf_z < 3

parent.catalogue: Bahar+2022 eFEDS (VizieR J/A+A/661/A7) x DELVE DR3 delve_dr3.decade_shear positions

verdicts.name: aqual|tensor_T|tidal|inv|m2|I1e-33
verdicts.verdict: source axis: the quadrupole is locked to the baryonic axis, so it lands in a2c where it is degenerate with baryonic ellipticity; a2s power is ZERO by construction

verdicts.name: aqual|tensor_d|tidal|inv|m2|I1e-33
verdicts.verdict: K grad Phi_N = exp(2AW/3) grad Phi_N EXACTLY -- the field direction is an eigenvector, so this tensor cannot turn the flux and predicts no quadrupole of any phase.  It is a scalar rescaling wearing a tensor's name.

verdicts.name: aqual|tensor_d|tidal|inv|m4|I1e-33
verdicts.verdict: K grad Phi_N = exp(2AW/3) grad Phi_N EXACTLY -- the field direction is an eigenvector, so this tensor cannot turn the flux and predicts no quadrupole of any phase.  It is a scalar rescaling wearing a tensor's name.

verdicts.name: rar|tensor_S[plaw_p0q1s2_L300]|phi|pow|m1|I3e+12
verdicts.verdict: member-well network: the axis is the member distribution, which is the frame the test stacks in, so the quadrupole again lands in a2c, not a2s

data_manifest.source: NOIRLab Astro Data Lab TAP, table delve_dr3.decade_shear (DECADE metacalibration shape catalogue, DELVE DR3). Unauthenticated; no credentials are sent.
data_manifest.x_ray_catalogue: Bahar+2022, VizieR J/A+A/661/A7 tables 1 and 2, 542 eFEDS systems, already on disk in ../lead01/ with its own manifests

selection_pass.note: POSITIONS AND REDSHIFTS ONLY -- this pass never requests a shape column, so the sample cannot have been selected on the quantity that is scored

shear_pass.note: metacalibration response recovered per radial bin from the 1p/1m/2p/2m sheared copies; the SELECTION response is not applied, which biases the shear AMPLITUDE by a few per cent but cancels in every ratio reported here

selection.query: SELECT ra,dec,dnf_z,mcal_w_noshear FROM delve_dr3.decade_shear WHERE 't' = q3c_radial_query(ra, dec, 129.532100, 0.417100, 0.919851) AND mcal_flags = 0 AND flags_foreground = 0 AND flags_footprint = 1 AND mcal_sel_noshear > 0 AND dnf_z > 0 AND dnf_z < 3

shear.query: SELECT ra,dec,mcal_g_1_noshear,mcal_g_2_noshear,mcal_w_noshear,dnf_z,mcal_g_1_1p,mcal_g_1_1m,mcal_g_2_2p,mcal_g_2_2m FROM delve_dr3.decade_shear WHERE 't' = q3c_radial_query(ra, dec, 128.510500, 2.577200, 0.275121) AND mcal_flags = 0 AND flags_foreground = 0 AND flags_footprint = 1 AND mcal_sel_noshear > 0 AND dnf_z > 0 AND dnf_z < 3

zenodo_hsc_y3_gama09h: 10.5281/zenodo.15482851 and its two siblings, titled 'HSC Y3 Shape Catalog -- GAMA09H Full Field'.  These describe exactly this field with e1/e2/RA/Dec and are SYNTHETIC: the creator list includes an LLM simulation assistant and the correction notice calls one of them 'an algorithmically scaled or pipeline-derived artifact'.  Not downloaded, not used, not consulted.
